summary:
I have found and fixed the bug. The issue was in `src/codegen.rs` where the `generate_getter` function produced generated methods that returned owned objects (`-> Company`) instead of references (`-> &Company`) for `FieldType::Ref` types. 

I updated the code generation logic so that it appropriately generates `-> &Company {`, matching the internal implementation which was correctly doing `&self.company`. 

I also noticed and fixed a minor syntax error in `test.sh` where `grep` was misinterpreting the query `->` as a command-line flag. After these changes, running `test.sh` completes cleanly with `PASS: All code generation tests passed`.
